changes.comment: Add a new `provideNpmrcCredentialsViaEnvironment` experiment for PNPM 10.34.2 through 10.x and PNPM 11.5.3 through versions earlier than 11.6.0. For these versions, Rush expands `${VAR}` tokens from the generated `.npmrc`, passing credentials using `npm_config_*` environment variables instead of writing them to disk. PNPM 11.6.0 and newer should instead receive URL-scoped `pnpm_config_//...` credentials directly from CI.
